extensions.scope: Observed local prototype, not a user-approved final visual identity. Ramps are synthesized preview metadata, not additional application colors. Browser interaction results were reported by the implementation agent; this review used saved captures.

characterRendering.player: 2D image-driven player: ImageGen transparent standing cutout and reference-based nine-pose atlas on a plane in the existing Three.js arena. Yellow body, pale belly and green eyes follow the supplied standing reference. Turquoise remains the HUD accent.
characterRendering.scope: Follows the user's direction to use the supplied image rather than code-built modeling; not an exact 3D reconstruction. Saved idle, guard and gameplay combo captures show correct facing, clean transparency and no visible atlas bleed or clipped limbs.

progressionUi.changeType: Scoped extension of the existing interface; user-directed character-info material and layout.
progressionUi.scope: growth-* tokens document the added HUD/account surfaces; info-* tokens document the reference-led character card. Existing global tokens, snippets and historical narrative are preserved. The top-level generatedAt belongs to the retained legacy snapshot.

surfaces.account: Blue-green / cream / milk-gold, rounded controls. Character upgrades are independent; wallet is shared. Real before/after values, costs, disabled funds/max states, selected inventory details and empty state.
surfaces.characterInfo: Reference-led deep brown translucent sheet, thin gold frame, centered KaiTi heading; current transparent idle frame at left, live status at center, buffs/harvest at right, permanent upgrades and inventory below. In-run upgrades are read-only; buying remains at the menu.

materials.name: info-sheet-background
materials.purpose: 用户指定角色卡深棕底色；不替换局外蓝绿面板。

materials.name: info-backdrop
materials.purpose: 角色信息卡背后战斗画面的遮罩。

materials.name: growth-backdrop
materials.purpose: 局外强化 / 背包遮罩。

materials.name: info-readonly-upgrade
materials.purpose: 局内只读升级价格胶囊；禁用不是购买入口。

layout.account: 1040px maximum, 90vh internally scrolling; upgrade art/list columns, inventory four-column grid/detail. At <=600px, sections stack and character choices scroll horizontally.
layout.characterInfo: 1500px maximum, width calc(100% - 80px), 92dvh maximum; top three columns, lower two columns. <=700px: width calc(100% - 22px), 94dvh maximum, sticky heading and close, six-column inventory.
layout.responsiveRadii: <=600px account dialog:18px; <=700px info sheet:16px and info subpanel:12px.

evidence.verificationBoundary: Documenter inspected source and all seven saved final captures. No browser, combat or save retest; no context/detector rerun. Mobile captures are viewport evidence, not physical-device acceptance.

progressionUi.previewMetadata: New tonal ramps are synthesized eight-step dark-to-light preview metadata, not extra application colors. Component snippets are static, self-contained style previews; runtime data and image assets remain in the game.

numbers.fit: one shared scale per statistics group

resultUi.behavior: Presentation only; campaign completion remains non-modal; existing combat, account and button handlers retained.

layout.desktop: original-ratio character on left; independently scrolling information on right
layout.mobile: one scrolling content column; fixed header and footer

characterShowcase.data: Numerical attributes and moves from Combat; upgrade progress from Growth and account. No new unlock rules, invented lore or evolution stages.
characterShowcase.interaction: Click opens preview; only confirm calls the existing selection transaction. Current/locked states disabled. Native modal blocks click-through; close button, backdrop and Escape preserve active character.

numericTypography.scope: all DOM UI; world-space Canvas numbers audited separately
numericTypography.fontPolicy: Preserve existing component font family, weight, nominal size and responsive hierarchy; serif readouts retain Georgia.
numericTypography.baseline: Text and numeric groups share first baseline; direct icon/track children align to geometric center.
numericTypography.fitting: One shared adapter; only overflowing groups shrink, nominal font restored on content/viewport change. No positional offsets or transforms applied to numbers.
numericTypography.componentDimensions: Existing row extents retained. Before/after upgrade and information card dimensions measured identical at 1440x900.
numericTypography.dataPolicy: No changes to numeric values, formatting units, combat, progression or persistence.

narrative.overview: This document records the existing local fighting-game prototype: a 2D image-driven player, a temporary articulated CPU, side-view combat and a dusk courtyard. The player uses a transparent standing cutout and reference-based nine-pose atlas on a plane in the Three.js arena, following the user's image-first correction. This is not an exact 3D reconstruction.
keyCharacteristics: Battlefield remains the main surface; health, energy and controls occupy screen edges.
Turquoise identifies the player HUD; the player image retains the supplied yellow character palette. Coral identifies the CPU.
Warm low-poly scenery contrasts with dark blue-green controls and cream text.

rules.name: The Two-Surface Rule
rules.body: 蓝绿奶金用于局外账户界面；深棕金边只用于用户指定的角色信息卡。后续扩展按所在组件选域，不把其中一域扩散为全站替换色板。

rules.name: The Read-Then-Buy Rule
rules.body: 角色卡提供局内查看；永久强化的消费动作只在主界面角色强化执行。两处保持同一份角色数值与账户事实。

dos: Do preserve the player's yellow body, pale belly and green eyes from the supplied reference; retain turquoise player and coral CPU HUD accents.
Do keep utility, energy and touch controls in separate rows on narrow screens.
Do describe the player as 2D image-driven and the CPU as a temporary articulated rig.
Do 保留当前角色透明站立图的比例、脚底与名称，切换角色时跟随真实素材。
Do 保持本局收获、永久账户余额与永久物品数量的语义区分。
Do 在手机角色卡内部滚动时保持标题与关闭入口可达，并保留局外购买说明。
donts: Don't present the image-driven player as an exact 3D reconstruction or the temporary CPU as a final likeness model.
Don't let an overlay continue live combat behind instructions or pause controls.
Don't infer untested device support from these documented breakpoints.
Don't 将深棕金边、局部光圈或圆润成长控件推广为旧菜单与战斗 UI 的全局替换规则。
Don't 把参考图烘焙成静态整页，或把合成验收数据、背包条目当作正式游戏内容。
